Help Centre

Frequently asked

How do I place an order?

Choose a product, select your preferred shade or option, add it to your bag and review the order before checkout.

Can I order more than one product?

Yes. You can add multiple products and adjust quantities directly from your shopping bag.

Can I select different shades?

Yes. Available shades and options are shown on each product detail page.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery timing depends on destination and the final shipping method. Confirmed estimates can be added before launch.

Can I exchange beauty products?

Exchange eligibility will follow ZENIOR's final store policy. Hygiene-sensitive products may be subject to additional conditions.
